تستأصلوا (form X)

# تُسْتَأْصَلُوا (tustaʔṣalū) /tus.taʔ.sˤa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْصَلَ (istaʔṣala)
